visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a white hoodie, stands in a brightly lit room that appears to be a classroom with a green chalkboard behind him. He speaks enthusiastically with vibrant facial expressions, gesturing frequently with his hands. Large yellow text boxes with red and black text occupy the middle of the screen. (2) The scene cuts to the same man, now wearing black-rimmed glasses and a black-and-white striped shirt, portraying a student. He looks thoughtful, placing a hand on his chin. Graphics of a brown crayon and a cup of green tea appear in the upper left corner to illustrate the linguistic point being discussed. (3) The man toggles between his two personas via rapid jump cuts. One wears the white hoodie and explains, while the other wears glasses and looks confused. Graphics of a red, yellow, and green traffic light appear. The man's facial expressions alternate between confident teaching and utter bewilderment. (4) A final linguistic example is shown with a graphic of three silver fish. The student persona expresses extreme shock, with wide eyes and a gaping mouth. A dramatic monochrome filter and jitter effect are applied to the frame for comedic emphasis during this heightened emotional moment. (5) The video returns to the original persona in the white hoodie. He smiles warmly and points toward the viewer, delivering a call to action. Promotional banners for an online Japanese course remain visible at the bottom of the frame throughout the sequence.
